features: Complete in-game character model overhaul: large layered procedural Canvas2D armor with helmet and eyes, articulated dual swords, shoulder plates, chest sigils, boots, cloaks, walking animation, dash trails, attack poses and champion-specific Frost, Ember and Void silhouettes.
New Sovereign Legacy menu and full-size character preview showing the real game model; new Codex model preview during battle.

Six claimable historical achievements: 40 defeats, reaching Wave 4, defeating three elites, defeating a realm boss, completing two expeditions, and earning 200 lifetime Renown; each yields one Eclipse Shard once.

Elite enemies have a seeded chance to drop rare Eclipse Shards; Void Monarch bosses have a higher chance and Void Tyrants guarantee a rare shard. Shards earned during a run are only banked when it ends in defeat.

Three armor styles (Warbound, Eclipse, Crowned). Eclipse and Crowned sets are unlocked through genuine achievement and boss requirements and then forged with shards; their appearance follows the selected champion into real battle without granting unfair stat bonuses.

New legacy localStorage key independent of original scores, Armory and personal PROXIMUS media. All old scores, relics, currencies, bosses, achievements eligibility, champion powers, weapon evolutions and four realm expeditions remain supported.
New offline-cached legacy UI, game-ready art, achievements, cosmetic wardrobe, rare loot animation and responsive iPhone layout without remote image dependencies.
privacy: Scores only in this game's localStorage; no access to Asset Alchemist video files.
